notes:
SUB-STUDY OF A MASTER PROTOCOL. Page 1 states verbatim: "This study H0P-MC-OA03 (NCT04627038) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". Master protocol identifier as printed: H0P-MC-CPMP (also "master protocol CPMP"; OA disease-state addendum "DSA CPMP(1)"). Nothing was filled from the master. This ISA defers to the master protocol / DSA for: the SoA beyond ISA-unique visits and procedures (p10 SoA note: "Please refer to master protocol CPMP and the OA DSA CPMP(1) SoAs for additional information."); objectives and endpoints (p8, p17); overall design (p18); eligibility (p20); lifestyle (p21, CPMP Section 5.3); concomitant therapy (p23); discontinuation (p25); AE/SAE (p26, "master protocol CPMP(a)"); statistics/populations (p28-29); clinical laboratory tests (p30: "The master protocol CPMP describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA. This table describes tests unique for ISA OA03."). SoA activities therefore without composition in this document: Hematology, Chemistry (only Cystatin-C and TSH listed under Chemistry as ISA-unique), Lipid panel; Evaluate all I/E criteria (master/DSA criteria plus ISA criteria [1025]-[1035] p20-21). Vital signs procedure details are deferred to the Manual of Operations (p26).
PROTOCOL VERSION (rule 11): the PDF holds only Protocol H0P-MC-OA03(a), Amendment Number a, approval date 03-Mar-2021 (p1-2); the SoA (p10-13) is from this version. The Summary of Changes table (p4-5) describes changes from the Original Protocol (25 August 2020): urinalysis replaced by urine drug screen (recorded under lab_and_purpose for Urine drug screen), telephone visits added, ECG and vital-sign notes corrected, PK window added, device return added, new Section 6.6. The original version is not in the PDF.
CROSS-REFERENCE: Section 6.6 Dose Modification found on p23; the titration scheme itself is redacted (CI on p23-24), so only the max dose and decision rule are printed.
PANELS: lab-tests table p30 checked from the page image (rule 10); the text layer runs the four columns together; the image confirms the column assignments (Chemistry: Cystatin-C, TSH; Additional Thyroid Tests: 4; Other SST-Regulated Hormones: 6; Other Tests: 5). A CCI redaction box sits between the main table and the Thyroid Safety Follow-Up table on p30. No specimen or lab is stated for any panel; Appendix 3 (p36) allows local laboratory testing in lieu of central laboratory testing only under exceptional circumstances. Panels whose SoA rows map by name: Thyroid panel ~ Additional Thyroid Tests/TSH, Cystatin C ~ Chemistry Cystatin-C, HbA1c and Serum pregnancy ~ Other Tests; the document does not state these links explicitly. Somatostatin-related biomarker sample: the document does not state which analytes it covers; the "Other SST-Regulated Hormones" column may relate but this is not stated; its lab_and_purpose entry is linked only via the word "biomarker" in Section 9.4.4.
CONFLICTS/DIFFERENCES (rule 5): ECG components differ between the SoA note (PR interval, QRS duration and interval, heart rate; p11) and Section 8.1.2 (heart rate, PR, QRS, QT and QTcF intervals; p26); both recorded as separate measurement entries. Serum pregnancy: p32 says a negative serum test "at the screening visit", while the ISA SoA schedules serum pregnancy at V3-V7/ED; both are recorded as printed.
INSTRUMENTS: none of this SoA's activities is an instrument; the category is empty. The document names a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) diary (p18-19) and the WOMAC Pain Subscale Score (p28) but these belong to the master/DSA SoAs.
ABBREVIATIONS: Appendix 4 list (p38, 19 entries, "endo of the T wave" kept as printed) plus the SoA table footer (p13) and lab-table footers (p30). Abbreviations under other tables not added: p15 (ECG, HR, TSH) and p22 (BID, IMP, NIMP). All tokens in SoA activity names (I/E, ECG, HbA1c, PK) are defined in the SoA footer on p13; none undefined.
REDACTIONS: schema (p8-9), objectives table (p17), dose titration (p23-24), parts of p27-28, p30 box; the "Participant returns device" row's notes cell is CCI (p13) - the device is described only as a "participant digital biomarker device" in the summary of changes (p4) and "digital biomarker analyses" (p29). No pages lack a text layer; p30 was the only page read from an image. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
